neighbours.label: The tokens ' slip', ' slipped', ' Slip' and ' sneak'; other verbs of motion and other words in the slot stay quiet.
fire: She managed to slip past the guards at night.
The fox slipped under the old fence.
A sneak attack took the town by surprise.
Try not to slip on the wet floor.
Kids sneak candy into the cinema.
This Slip resistant mat is cheap.
He wants to sneak a look at the file.
The note slipped behind the desk.
quiet: She managed to run past the guards at night.
The fox crawled under the old fence.
A dawn attack took the town by surprise.
Try not to stand on the wet floor.
Kids bring candy into the cinema.
This Heat resistant mat is cheap.
He wants to take a look at the file.
The note fell behind the desk.

notes: Probes: 0.83-1.06 in every sense tried (slip into, sneak peek, Slipstream, slip a boat). Near misses under 0.09. 'slip' and 'sneak' share quiet movement, but ' Slipstream' and 'sneak peek' fire just as hard, so the label stays at word level. On this pole the output direction promotes 'pery', ' into', ' silently', ' peek'. 'ak' after 'Sne' at a text start read 1.06 and is not tested.
